title: Lot 47 · Andrea Fletcher
desc: Clicks "Place on payment plan" on the ledger
structure: The .main-col carries inline style position:relative; so the overlay is scoped to the main column and the sidebar stays sharp. Topbar contains only h1 "Lot 47 · Andrea Fletcher" — no back chevron, no top-search, no top-right. The .content block carries inline style filter:blur(1.5px);opacity:.5; and holds a reduced backdrop: div.ledger-head > div.unit-summary containing div.us-top (a single wrapper div with div.us-name "Andrea Fletcher" and div.us-unit "Phase 2 · Lot 47" — note only TWO middot parts here, no household suffix, and no age-badge), then div.us-bal "$12,400.00", then div.us-bal-lbl "TOTAL OUTSTANDING". There is no us-age-row, no action-stack, no subnav and no statement card behind the modal. Sibling to .content is div.modal-overlay (position:absolute; inset:0; rgba(11,31,51,.55); flex-centred; z-index 50) containing div.modal-card (460px wide, white, radius 18, padding 26). Inside the card, in order: (1) div.modal-head with h2 "Place Lot 47 on a payment plan" and div.modal-close holding an X svg. (2) div.modal-sub "This pauses all automated dunning reminders for this unit while the plan is active." (3) div.m-field — label "Total amount to schedule" over div.m-input.focused (amber focus ring) with span "$12,400.00". (4) div.m-two-col holding two div.m-field: label "Number of instalments" over div.m-input span "4", and label "Frequency" over div.m-input span "Monthly". (5) div.m-field — label "First instalment date" over div.m-input span "Sep 28, 2026". (6) div.m-field — label "Instalment amount" over div.m-input carrying inline style background:var(--navy-100); with span "$3,100.00 per instalment" (read-only/computed field). (7) div.plan-note — a navy-100 tinted callout with a check-in-circle svg and p "Andrea will see this plan and its due dates in her Dues statement. If an instalment is missed, dunning resumes automatically." (8) div.modal-btns — two flex:1 buttons: div.stack-btn.outline span "Cancel" and div.stack-btn.amber span "Create payment plan" (both text-only, no svg, centred by .modal-btns .stack-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;}).
domain_needs: payment_plan.unit_id → Lot 47; modal heading composed as "Place {unit_label} on a payment plan"
payment_plan.total_amount = "$12,400.00" — defaulted from unit.total_outstanding (the ledger closing balance on screen 6); editable, so it must be stored on the plan rather than recomputed
payment_plan.frequency = "Monthly" — enumeration; at minimum Monthly, likely also Weekly/Fortnightly

payment_plan.instalment_amount = "$3,100.00" — DERIVED, read-only (grey navy-100 input): total_amount ÷ instalment_count = 12,400.00 ÷ 4 = 3,100.00; suffix text " per instalment" is part of the rendered string
payment_plan.status = active/completed/defaulted, and payment_plan.pauses_dunning = true — the sub-copy states the plan pauses ALL automated dunning reminders for the unit while active
payment_plan.auto_resume_dunning_on_missed_instalment = true — "If an instalment is missed, dunning resumes automatically"
payment_plan_instalment entity: sequence number, due_date (derived from first_instalment_date + frequency × n), amount, status (due/paid/missed)
resident visibility flag: the plan and its due dates appear in the resident's Dues statement in the resident app — plan.visible_to_resident
resident.first_name = "Andrea" used verbatim in the plan-note copy and possessive "her" implies resident.pronoun or gendered copy is generated per-resident
form state: the "Total amount to schedule" input is the focused field on load (m-input.focused, amber ring)
modal actions: Cancel (dismiss, no write) and Create payment plan (persist)
backdrop state: the underlying ledger route stays /finance/units/lot-47 while the modal is open, so the plan modal is a route-level or state-level overlay, not a separate page
accounting_notes: PAYMENT PLAN SCHEDULING against an existing AR balance. Figures verbatim: "Total amount to schedule" $12,400.00; "Number of instalments" 4; "Frequency" Monthly; "First instalment date" Sep 28, 2026; "Instalment amount" $3,100.00 per instalment. TIE: 4 × $3,100.00 = $12,400.00 exactly, and $12,400.00 is the same closing AR balance as the Lot 47 statement on screen 6 and the arrears row on screen 5 — the plan schedules the whole existing debit balance, it does not create new debt. Accounting consequence: a payment plan is a memorandum/scheduling record over the existing AR balance, not a journal entry — the receivable is already recognised, so creating the plan should post NO debit or credit; each instalment when received posts DR Bank / CR Unit AR $3,100.00. The plan does change the ageing treatment (it suppresses dunning), so the system must record whether an on-plan balance still ages into the 30/60/90+ buckets shown on screens 5 and 6. No account codes, no debit/credit columns and no trial balance appear on this screen.
